company.name: WeaveGrid
company.shortDescription: WeaveGrid develops electrification software for the scalable deployment of electric vehicles on the electric grid.
company.description: WeaveGrid operates with utilities and owners of electric vehicles (EV) to allow and speed up transportation electrification. Using machine learning, optimization, and predictive analytics, the company's software solution solves several EV-grid integration challenges for utilities in a systems-oriented manner; helps integrate renewable energy resources on the grid; and saves utility customers' money on their bills.

productsAndServices.description: A DERMS platform that gives utilities visibility into local grid capacity and automates dispatch of EVs, home batteries, and other flexible loads to manage constraints from transformers to the bulk system.
productsAndServices.name: DISCO (Distribution-Integrated System Capacity Orchestration)

productsAndServices.description: Software and program services that connect EV drivers and charging equipment to utility incentives, then optimize charging around electricity costs, grid conditions, renewable availability, and customer driving needs.
productsAndServices.name: Utility EV Managed Charging Programs

productsAndServices.description: Integration software and partner APIs that enable automakers, charging providers, battery manufacturers, and aggregators to connect customer-owned EVs and energy resources with utility programs and grid dispatch.
productsAndServices.name: Grid-Interactive DER Integration

productsAndServices.description: A consumer-facing service that helps EV drivers identify eligible utility charging programs, connect a vehicle or home charger, receive charging guidance, and earn incentives for flexible charging.
productsAndServices.name: EV Driver Charging Enrollment and Rewards Platform

aiResearchSummary.text: Electric vehicle detection describes methods that use multi month electricity usage data, captured at multiple intervals per day for many user locations, to infer where electric vehicles are present. Optimized charging of electric vehicles over distribution grid presents techniques for scheduling EV charging that respect ratings and limits of local low voltage distribution transformers. Together these efforts focus on data driven EV detection and grid aware optimization of charging behavior.
